Author: Kagekazu
Name: RelicTracker
Punchline: Track relic progress and materials across inventory and retainers.
Description: Track relic weapon, tool, and armor progress across every job. Owned relic detection and live material counts from Allagan Tools (replicas included). Optional FFXIV Collect sync for relics you no longer have.
Changelog:
- Less stuttering in busy zones like Eureka Hydatos when loot is flying.
- Craft with Artisan works with the latest Artisan relic craft lists (update Artisan if the button is missing).
- Starts without blocking the game thread.
- Right-click relics, replicas, materials, and armor to jump to Relic or Tracker.
- Armor pieces track from inventory; higher tiers (and Phantom Vision / Augmented Law's Order) credit lower sets.
- Cosmic tool stages and replicas count as owned. Progress is saved per character.
